catalog.title: Guides
catalog.subtitle: Short, focused walkthroughs. Pick one to replay it whenever you need.
catalog.empty: No guides are available for your account.

controls.offRoute: This step lives on another page. Go back to that page to continue the tour.

student-start.title: Start with practice
student-start.description: Practice first at your own pace. Challenges are optional and open whenever you are ready.

dashboard.title: Your progress
dashboard.body: This is your home. It shows how many practices and challenges you have done — tap a card to open that page.

actions.title: Two ways to start
actions.body: Practice is untimed: solve questions and check your score. Challenges are timed events. Start with practice.

practice.title: The practice page
practice.body: Every practice you start shows up here with its score and duration. Finished ones stay available to review.

practice-start.title: Create a practice
practice-start.body: Tap Start practice and the questions open right away. You can change answers until you submit.

runner-header.title: While you practise
runner-header.body: The header shows the practice title, the current question, and the autosave status. Answers are saved as you type.

runner-pager.title: Move between questions
runner-pager.body: Use the numbers to jump to any question. Green means answered, blue is the current question.

runner-submit.title: Submit when ready
runner-submit.body: Submit finishes the attempt and opens your score. Nothing is graded before that.

result.title: Your result
result.body: The score card summarises the attempt. Every finished attempt opens with a celebration.

answers.title: Review your answers
answers.body: Scroll down to compare your answer with the correct one for each question.

guide.title: Come back any time
guide.body: Open this menu and choose Guide (inside Settings on a phone). You can replay this tour, or take the Events tour when you want to join a challenge.

student-event.title: Join an event
student-event.description: Timed challenges from your teacher. Optional — try one when you feel ready.

event-list.title: Choose a challenge
event-list.body: Each card shows the category, time limit, deadline, and your status. Challenges that match your category can be started right away.

event-start.title: Start the challenge
event-start.body: Tap Start to create an attempt. If you already started, the button becomes Continue.

runner-header.title: During the challenge
runner-header.body: The header shows the challenge title, the current question, and the autosave status. Answers are saved as you type.

runner-timer.title: Watch the timer
runner-timer.body: The countdown turns amber near the end and submits the attempt automatically when time runs out.

runner-pager.title: Move between questions
runner-pager.body: Use the numbers to jump to any question. Green means answered, blue is the current question.

runner-submit.title: Submit when ready
runner-submit.body: Submit finishes the attempt and opens your score. You can keep changing answers until then.

result.title: Your result
result.body: The score card summarises the attempt. From here you can go back to the challenge list or your dashboard.

student-results.title: Check your results
student-results.description: Open a finished practice or challenge and read your score.

list.title: Find a finished attempt
list.body: Finished challenges show a View result button — tap it to open the score. Finished practices are listed on the Practice page.

score.title: Score card
score.body: This is your final score. The celebration plays every time you open a completed attempt.

admin-dashboard.title: Dashboard overview
admin-dashboard.description: Read the platform statistics and recent activity.

welcome.title: Welcome to your dashboard
welcome.body: This short guide shows where the key numbers live and how to drill into events, questions, and practice.

stats.title: Platform statistics
stats.body: These counters summarise activity for the current period. Use them to spot busy events and active or inactive students.

totals.title: Totals
totals.body: Total students and schools come from the student directory. They update as students are registered.

charts.title: Breakdowns
charts.body: Compare students by school and category. Hover a bar or slice to read the exact numbers.

recent.title: Recent activity
recent.body: The latest events and students appear here. Click an item to open its detail page.

admin-quiz.title: Add a quiz question
admin-quiz.description: Create a question, fill in the content, and save it to the bank.

list.title: Open the question bank
list.body: Every question lives here. Click Add Question to create a new one.

detail.title: Basic details
detail.body: Choose the code and type. The category prefix drives the suggested code.

content.title: Question content
content.body: Write the description and question with rich text, then fill the answer options. Use the editor toolbar for images and formatting.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Set the category, difficulty, status, and topic. Saving validates the required fields.

save.title: Save the question
save.body: Save becomes available once there are unsaved changes. After saving you land on the question detail.

admin-event.title: Create an event and read results
admin-event.description: Build a challenge, publish it, then open its results.

list.title: Create an event
list.body: Start a new challenge here. Existing events are listed below.

details.title: Event details
details.body: Set the name, category, duration, deadline, and description. Tick Publish to make it visible to students.

questions.title: Pick questions
questions.body: Only active questions from the event's category are listed. Select at least one question to enable Save.

save.title: Save the event
save.body: Saving opens the event detail, where the challenge is ready to test or share.

open.title: Open the event
open.body: Click an event row to open its detail. Any event in the list works.

results-link.title: View results
results-link.body: From the event detail, click View Results to see every submitted attempt.

results.title: Results table
results.body: Each row is a submitted attempt with score, duration, and submit time. Use the back button to return to the event.

admin-practice.title: Review practice sheets
admin-practice.description: Open a student's practice sheet and inspect the shuffle and answers.

list.title: All practice sheets
list.body: Every sheet created by students is listed with its school, category, score, and status. Filter by category if needed.

settings.title: Practice settings
settings.body: Admins can change how many questions each new sheet contains. The value applies to future sheets only.

row.title: Open a sheet
row.body: Click any row to open the sheet. You will see the questions before and after shuffling, plus the submitted answers.

before.title: Before shuffle
before.body: This is the original question set selected for the student.

after.title: After shuffle
after.body: The shuffled order is what the student actually answered. Options may also be reordered.

answers.title: Submitted answers
answers.body: Each question shows the student's answer and whether it was correct.

backup.exportDesc: Download a complete SQL backup of every application table, including settings, roles, audit log and API keys.
backup.importWarn: Restoring replaces every table covered by the backup
backup.importDesc: Pick a .sql file created by Export. Its tables are replaced in one transaction, so the database stays untouched if the restore fails. Before anything is replaced, the current database is downloaded automatically as a pre-restore safety copy.
backup.confirmMessage: Restore {name}? Rows in the tables it covers will be replaced and cannot be recovered. The current database is downloaded first as a safety copy.
backup.snapshotFailed: Safety copy failed, nothing was restored
